description: Changes the settings of one AI receptionist, named by id. Only the fields sent change (a list is sent whole). booking, crm and payments: what it may do. A capability is switched on with an integration account of this workspace that is used on the receptionist’s WhatsApp number; it lets Cosend’s AI make, move and cancel bookings, write to the CRM, or send payment links, for customers. payments: on, account_id (the payment account it uses, such as Stripe or PayPal, connected on this number), max_link_amount (the most one link may ask for) and link_expiry_minutes (how long a link stays open, inside what the payment service allows); switching it off does not check the account. selling: on, and cash_not_taken: before saving a receptionist that sells with delivery, ask the owner "When a customer picks cash on delivery where you don’t take cash: hand the chat to you, or send a payment link?" and send hand_over or payment_link (hand_over until set). permissions: what it may do on its own, destructive, payments and refunds, each off, ask_first or on_its_own; only the types sent change, and only an owner or an admin changes them. location is the business location the receptionist can send as a map pin when a customer asks where the business is: latitude and longitude, or maps_link (the business’s Google Maps link, from which Cosend reads the position, and refuses in words a link with none), each with an optional name and address; null takes it off, and the receptionist answers with the address in words. Each change needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Owners and admins.

booking.description: Bookings. on: Whether the AI receptionist does this. Off until switched on, with an account. account_id: The integration account it works through (`ca_…`): one of this workspace’s, used on the receptionist’s WhatsApp number. customer_confirms: the customer confirms a booking or a move with a tap (a cancellation in every case). services: what can be booked, each with its name, minutes, buffer_minutes kept free after it, price and the booking tool’s own service. hours, breaks, holidays, horizon_days (how far ahead), notice_minutes (before a booking), cancel_notice_minutes (before a move or a cancellation), max_per_day (per customer), notify (every, failures or none).

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

crm.description: The CRM. on: Whether the AI receptionist does this. Off until switched on, with an account. account_id: The integration account it works through (`ca_…`): one of this workspace’s, used on the receptionist’s WhatsApp number. writes: beside the contact, a note, a deal, a task or a ticket. deal: the pipeline and stage a deal goes into. chat_log: the chat goes to the CRM at the hand-over, at Done, both, or not at all. notify (every, failures or none).

id.description: The id in the resource path.

location.description: The business location the assistant can send as a map pin: latitude and longitude, or maps_link (the business’s Google Maps link, which Cosend reads the position from), each with an optional name and address. null takes it off.

payments.description: Payments: it sends the customer a link to pay a price the business set. on: Whether the AI receptionist does this. Off until switched on, with an account. account_id: the payment account it uses, such as Stripe or PayPal (`ca_…`): one of this workspace’s, used on the receptionist’s WhatsApp number. max_link_amount: the most one link may ask for (amount_minor in the currency’s smallest unit, currency in lower case), null for no limit. link_expiry_minutes: how long a link stays open, inside what the payment service allows; null sets none, and the payment service’s own rule applies.

permissions.description: What it may do on its own, per action type: only the types sent change. An owner or an admin only.

selling.description: Selling. on: switch it on or off on its own; sent with type, this one wins. cash_not_taken: Ask the owner: "When a customer picks cash on delivery where you don’t take cash: hand the chat to you, or send a payment link?" hand_over: a person takes the chat (the default). payment_link: the order is paid by link and its link sent, as "Send a payment link" allows; with payment links off for the number, a person takes the chat.

type.description: customer_service: it answers and helps, and sells nothing (the default). sales: customer service and sales: it takes orders for the number’s products, and takes payments when a payment account is on for it.

name: update_receptionist_settings
title: Change the AI receptionist’s settings
